'''Family Meen-tris''' was an [[Eickarie]] family. [[Empire of the Hand]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Su-mil]] was a member of the family.<ref name="FB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Family Meen-Tris first appeared in the [[2004]] [[eBook]] novella ''[[Fool's Bargain]]'' by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="FB" />
